tool.name: ampvis2 core community analysis
tool.description: Core community plot analysis using ampvis2

param.name: input_rds
param.label: Ampvis2 RDS dataset
param.help: An ampvis2 RDS dataset generated by the ampvis2: load or subset tools.

param.name: metadata
param.label: Metadata list
param.help: Metadata list output from ampvis2: load or subset tools.

param.name: groupby
param.label: Group by metadata variable
param.help: Metadata variable to group samples by for analysis.

param.name: top
param.label: Top OTUs to consider
param.help: Number of top abundant OTUs to include in the core community analysis.

param.name: normalise
param.label: Normalise abundances
param.help: Whether to normalise raw counts to percentages.

tool.help:
# Core Community Analysis
This tool generates a core community plot to visualize the most abundant OTUs across sample groups.
## Input Requirements
- An ampvis2 RDS dataset - Metadata list from ampvis2 tools
## Parameters
- **Group by**: Metadata variable to group samples - **Top OTUs**: Number of top OTUs to analyze (default: 10) - **Normalise**: Normalise counts to percentages (default: yes)
## Output
- HTML plot showing core community composition
